project_type: Full-stack app: React/Vite frontend + Express.js backend with SQLite (better-sqlite3)
build_system: npm for both frontend and backend. Frontend uses Vite. Backend is plain Node.js with no build step.
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/anotnigeia && npm run build (frontend only; backend has no build step)
verification_instructions: 1. Install backend deps: cd server && npm install. 2. Run server: node server/index.js (should start without crash). 3. Frontend build: npm run build (should succeed).
environment_constraints: Network is available for npm install. PostgreSQL connection is remote (Neon). No local DB needed.
key_patterns: Backend: synchronous better-sqlite3 with db.prepare().run/get/all(). All route handlers are synchronous. Uses CommonJS require. Frontend API layer in src/services/api.ts uses relative '/api' base URL with Vite proxy in dev. Auth via JWT Bearer token from localStorage (princess-auth key).
directory_structure: Root: React frontend (src/, vite.config.ts, package.json). server/: Express backend (index.js, package.json, .env.example, Procfile). src/services/api.ts: API client layer. src/stores/: Zustand stores (authStore, userStore, blogStore).
